gaps.islamqa.126387.f001: The text permits charity, handing it to the officials, or announcing it, and never says he may keep it, unlike 126502.f001 with the same facts; the facts carry no distinction between the two answers.
gaps.islamqa.107436.f001: Public money spent on public-interest channels without asking whether the paying body can take it back; with the state as an identifiable owner, the oracle returns it to the owner, as 260724.f001's text does.
gaps.islamqa.287215.f002: The text permits a choice: hold her share for her or give it in charity on her behalf. A ruling records one option; the oracle gives the charity route (publicInterest).
